scope: One genuine Waymo-only source model following official100epoch recipe, real12step FP32 backward timing first, train/sourceVAL only. No mixed checkpoint initialization and no TTA.
new_authorization_applies_to: new round6 registration only; no edits/deletes of historical P0 locks
allowed_initialization: Official default random nontext model, independent general-pretrained RoBERTa-base; frozen text weights, training dropout per official implementation
forbidden: No released three-platform union checkpoint load/finetune, no target-platform labels for construction or model selection, no unrelated paused work
primary_checkpoint: epoch100 predeclared; sourceVAL-best checkpoint may be secondary and never selected by Drone/Quad
GPU_policy: single serialized GPU owner under existing research/round2/gpu.lock; preserve unrelated ToDesk
execution: realNCCL rank0/worldsize1 required; finite100epochs with trace/checkpoints/meaningful validation, no automatic sweeps
model_goal: strict source-trained weights usable for later Waymo→Drone/Quad comparison
